pk.context: 140 mg subcutaneous, single dose, healthy adults

pill.desc: clear, pale yellow solution in a prefilled single-dose pen

tell: An effective half-life of 11 to 17 days and a monthly 420 mg option set this PCSK9-directed antibody apart.

clues.text: Absolute bioavailability after subcutaneous dosing is about 72%. Clearance runs through saturable binding to its target at low concentrations and a non-saturable proteolytic pathway at higher ones.
Made in genetically engineered Chinese hamster ovary cells, at about 144 kDa, and supplied as a sterile, preservative-free solution.
Approved under BLA 125522 as 140 mg/mL prefilled pens, autoinjectors and syringes, dosed every 2 weeks or as 420 mg monthly.
No boxed warning. Contraindicated after serious hypersensitivity to it or its excipients, including angioedema; myalgia is the most common reaction leading to stopping treatment.
Reducing major cardiovascular events in adults at increased risk, and lowering LDL cholesterol in hypercholesterolemia, including familial forms from age 10.
Binds PCSK9 and prevents it from binding LDL receptors, so more receptors remain to clear LDL from the blood.
The generic name begins with E and has ten letters.
